district.description: The heartland of Chettinad culture, Sivaganga is distinguished by its palatial mansions, fiery culinary heritage, and groundbreaking archaeological discoveries that push back the antiquity of the Sangam era.

culturalEntries.title: Keeladi Excavations - Sangam Era Civilization
culturalEntries.shortDescription: An ongoing archaeological excavation on the banks of the Vaigai river revealing an advanced urban, literate Sangam-era settlement dating back to the 6th century BCE.
culturalEntries.fullDescription: Located along the Vaigai river, Keeladi is a watershed archaeological site that has profoundly reshaped the understanding of South Indian history. Excavations have unearthed a thriving, secular, and literate urban civilization dating as far back as 580 BCE. Findings include advanced brick structures, closed drainage systems, ring wells, exquisite pottery with Tamil-Brahmi inscriptions, weaving tools, and carnelian beads indicating trade with Rome and the Indus Valley. It provides hard evidence for the urbanized nature of the classical Sangam period.
culturalEntries.historyOrigin: Carbon dated to the 6th century BCE, active during the Sangam period.
culturalEntries.culturalSignificance: Bridges the historical gap between the Indus Valley Civilization and the Sangam era, proving that a literate, industrialized urban society existed in Tamil Nadu over 2600 years ago.
culturalEntries.sourceReferences: State Archaeological and Historical Documentation; Tamil Nadu Tourism

chatbotKnowledge.answerEn: Keeladi in Sivaganga district is an ancient archaeological site on the Vaigai river. Excavations have revealed a highly advanced, literate Sangam-era urban civilization dating back to 580 BCE, featuring Tamil-Brahmi inscribed pottery and brick structures.
chatbotKnowledge.answerTa: சிவகங்கை மாவட்டத்தில் வைகை ஆற்றங்கரையில் அமைந்துள்ள கீழடி அகழாய்வு, சங்க காலத் தமிழர்களின் வளமான நாகரிகத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இங்கு கி.மு. 6-ஆம் நூற்றாண்டைச் சேர்ந்த தமிழ் பிராமி எழுத்துக்கள், செங்கல் கட்டிடங்கள் மற்றும் நகர நாகரிகத்தின் சான்றுகள் கிடைத்துள்ளன.
